limitations: Scoped to native segwit source generation. Standard,2FA, multisig, Android, BIP39 import and legacy restore are different modes.
Non-selectable: exact released artifact and independent wallet recovery not verified. A source commit is a singleton evidence boundary, not an all-version support promise.
guidance: Use the original wallet backup procedure and match exact product, platform, version and mode. Never enter a complete phrase or external recovery secret into Tessaveil.
